toolExecution.title: Where files are processed
toolExecution.description: Renaming, moving, deleting and extracting affect files in the current Bakabase service. In Docker, only container folders and mounted folders are available.
toolExecution.useHere: Want to organize files on this computer? Open this tool in your local Bakabase.
toolExecution.switchFailed: Could not switch back. Try again, or open this computer from the tray menu.
toolExecution.appFallback: Nothing opened? Install or update Bakabase on this computer, then try again. Your browser cannot confirm whether the app started.
toolExecution.localServerDescription: Enter the address of a service running on this computer to open the same tool in a new tab. A local Docker service still needs its folders mounted.
toolExecution.invalidAddress: Enter an http:// or https:// address using localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1], with an optional port and no additional path.
toolExecution.deviceMenu: You can also switch to this computer from the device menu below the logo in the sidebar. The shortcut above opens the same tool for you.
